newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian telecoms stocks suspended in Milan.
newsitem.headline: Italian telecoms stocks suspended in Milan.

text.p: Ordinary and savings shares in state telecoms operator Telecom Italia and state telecoms holding Stet were suspended for 30 minutes on the Milan bourse pending a statement, market watchdog Consob said.
A Consob spokesman said the suspension ran from 1217 to 1247 GMT.
Stet ordinary shares last traded at 6330 lire after closing at 6175 on Friday, while Telecom shares stood at 3570 lire after 3442 on Friday.
Stet savings were priced at 4560 lire against 4430 at the close while Telecom savings stood at 2730 against 2665.
Shareholders at industrial holding group IRI are meeting on Monday to approve the transition of IRI-controlled Stet to the Treasury and discuss the merger of Stet and Telecom Italia.
